opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection to Scotland), enrolled on or holding an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, and not eligible for government tuition fee support. Applicants must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course duration, or be an asylum seeker. Household income thresholds apply (e.g. £30,000 single no children, £35,000 couple no children).
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for students from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, studying an undergraduate degree at an eligible Scottish higher education institution. Includes a second-degree reskilling route in skills-shortage subject areas.
